উভয় পাশে cos: $2x=\cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\cos^{-1}(2y)\right)=0\cdot\cos(\ldots)+\sin\frac{3\pi}{2}\cdot\ldots=-\sin(\cos^{-1}2y)=-\sqrt{1-4y^{2}}$।
বর্গে: $4x^{2}=1-4y^{2}$ ⇒ $x^{2}+y^{2}=\frac{1}{4}$ (দেখানো হলো)।

**গ.** $\cos x+\sqrt{3}\cos(\frac{\pi}{2}-x)=\cos x+\sqrt{3}\sin x=2\cos\left(x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\sqrt{2}$
⇒ $\cos\left(x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ ⇒ $x=\frac{\pi}{3}\pm\frac{\pi}{4}+2n\pi$।
∴ $x=2n\pi+\frac{\pi}{12},\ 2n\pi+\frac{7\pi}{12}$।

**ক.** $\cos2\theta+\sin\theta=1$ ⇒ $1-2\sin^{2}\theta+\sin\theta=1$ ⇒ $\sin\theta(1-2\sin\theta)=0$।
$\sin\theta=0$ ⇒ $\theta=n\pi$; $\sin\theta=\frac{1}{2}$ ⇒ $\theta=n\pi+(-1)^{n}\frac{\pi}{6}$।

**খ.** $\sqrt{3}\cos\theta+\sin\theta=2\cos\left(\theta-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=1$ ⇒ $\cos\left(\theta-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=\frac{1}{2}$
⇒ $\theta-\frac{\pi}{6}=\pm\frac{\pi}{3}+2n\pi$ ⇒ $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}+2n\pi$ বা $\theta=-\frac{\pi}{6}+2n\pi$।
$0<\theta<2\pi$-এ: $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2},\ \frac{11\pi}{6}$।

**গ.** $\cos(\pi\sin\theta)=\sin(\pi\cos\theta)=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\pi\cos\theta\right)$
⇒ $\pi\sin\theta=\pm\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\pi\cos\theta\right)+2n\pi$ (n=0-তে):
শাখা-১: $\sin\theta+\cos\theta=\frac{1}{2}$ ⇒ $\sqrt{2}\sin\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{1}{2}$ ⇒ $\sin\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}$;
শাখা-২: $\cos\theta-\sin\theta=\frac{1}{2}$ ⇒ $\cos\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}$।
উভয় শাখা মিলিয়ে: $\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}=\pm\tan^{-1}\sqrt{7}$ ⇒ $\theta=\pm\frac{\pi}{4}+\tan^{-1}\sqrt{7}$ (যেহেতু $\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}=\frac{\pi}{4}-\tan^{-1}\sqrt{7}$, $\cos^{-1}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}=\tan^{-1}\sqrt{7}$) (দেখানো হলো)।

**ক.** $\tan^{2}\theta+1=3\operatorname{cosec}^{2}\theta$ ⇒ $\sec^{2}\theta=3\operatorname{cosec}^{2}\theta$ ⇒ $\frac{1}{\cos^{2}\theta}=\frac{3}{\sin^{2}\theta}$ ⇒ $\tan^{2}\theta=3$ ⇒ $\tan\theta=\pm\sqrt{3}$ ⇒ $\theta=n\pi\pm\frac{\pi}{3}$।

**খ.** $\sqrt{3}\sin x+\cos x=2\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=1$ ⇒ $\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=\frac{1}{2}$
⇒ $x+\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{\pi}{6}+2n\pi$ ⇒ $x=2n\pi$; বা $x+\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{5\pi}{6}+2n\pi$ ⇒ $x=\frac{2\pi}{3}+2n\pi$।
$-2\pi<x<2\pi$-এ: $x=0,\ -\frac{4\pi}{3},\ \frac{2\pi}{3}$।

**গ.** $\cos x+\cos3x+\cos5x+\cos7x=0$ ⇒ $\cos4x\cdot\cos2x\cdot\cos x=0$ (৭৪১-খ-এর মতো), 0<x<π:
